failures.detail: Before the input freeze (input-freeze.tsv, time in input-freeze-time.txt) the reviewer printed the intake DECISION.md and the first 80 lines of the intake manifest.json while locating inputs. Both were later hash-validated: DECISION.md sha256 f84b1b5a... matches the intake manifest; manifest.json is frozen in input-freeze.tsv. No scientific reading (brief/source) preceded the freeze.

Semantic Scholar /paper/arXiv:1801.08029 returned HTTP 429 (fetched/index/s2-paper.json). A second Semantic Scholar request (/citations, different endpoint) that was already scripted in the same shell command went out 3 s later and returned 200 (fetched/index/s2-citations.json). It was not a retry of the 429 URL, but it was a further request to a host that had just rate-limited us. No further Semantic Scholar requests were made.

python3 -I ignores PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, so scripts/prior_check.py importing scripts/indep_check.py wrote scripts/__pycache__/indep_check.cpython-314.pyc (sha256 and size in failures/F02-pycache-written.tsv). It was deleted after its hash was recorded. Later runs use python3 -I -B.

The guarded run of scripts/prior_check.py exceeded the 120 s foreground tool timeout (not a guard limit) and was moved to the background by the harness. It completed under helper_guard with guard_exit 0, wall 171.9 s < 230 s. The k=1600 instance is computed twice (loop nk=20 and the explicit Example 4.1 call), which is redundant work and not an error.

Duplicates were removed after hash comparison to avoid overcollection. (1) fetched/pdf/1801.08029v2.pdf was byte-identical (cmp) to the retained r480 PDF (sha ef8f72d4...), and its fetch-log row is kept. (2) derived 1801.08029 v2 layout text sha 6a9432d9... was identical to the retained .txt. (3) derived v2 raw (non-layout) text sha 0f96f0604bc1612e59beccb551df14cec710d33ecf602e749921cf9a5135079c was not needed.
